bphs-97:santhanam:ch09:v43-45.exact_text: 43-45. Parents. Surya is the indicator of father for all beings, while the mother is indicated by Chandra. Should Surya receive a Drishti from one, or more malefics, or be hemmed between them, this will cause evils to father. Similarly Chandra be considered in respect of mother. Malefics in the 6<sup>th</sup> , the 8<sup>th</sup> , or the 4<sup>th</sup> from Surya will bring inauspicious results about the father. Malefics in such places from Chandra will be adverse for the mother. The strength, or otherwise of the occupants concerned be suitably estimated.
